title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Do they form a linear pattern, or do they suggest a different type of relationship?

title: Linear Function Check
text: Consider if a linear function like $$f(x)=x$$ could fit the data. Does the pattern of the points suggest a straight line?

title: Choosing the Right Function
text: Which function would best fit a linear pattern in the data?
